name: nice.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.
lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
summary: www.nice.com scores 56 out of 100 (D). 9 checks fail now, 29 are at risk, and 24 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 99 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 118 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /products/proactive-outbound-engagement, /company/trust-center/availability-uptime, /services/customer-support, /partners and 94 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 93 elements on /products/proactive-outbound-engagement, /company/trust-center/availability-uptime, /services/customer-support, for example a[aria-label="About Us - open in same tab"] and li:nth-child(2) > a[aria-label="Careers - open in…
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: Elements must only use permitted ARIA attributes
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 55 elements on /company/trust-center/availability-uptime, for example tr:nth-child(1) > td:nth-child(2) > .group.relative.inline-flex > .status-dot.dot-green[aria-label="Platform Available " and tr:nth-child(1) > td:nth-child(3) >…

fix.title: 1 internal link leads to an error
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: CookieYes was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw cookies _mkto_trk.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The largest element paints in 0.7 s
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Language alternates point at each other
